digest.component_or_area: LLM model class resolution and verifier path
propositions: Three verifier code paths (verify.py:269, completion.py:332, code-review.yaml) independently downgrade to default model by comparing cfg.model to a constant, breaking when non-default providers configure the standard class
The equality heuristic fails for provider-qualified model IDs (e.g. anthropic:claude-opus-4-8) because substring matching or exact matching does not recognize them as the default model

A single reserved-word resolver in model_classes.resolve_model_string() must handle trivial/standard/frontier class names and be called consistently at all three verifier call sites and in config.resolve_model()
Code-review.yaml's verify step lacks a model: key entirely, causing it to fall through to cfg.model (frontier) and lose determinism from temperature: 0 configuration
Provider-qualified model strings returned by resolve_class cause string-level regression in logs and tests even though functionally equivalent to bare IDs
